summary: Backfill fitting native resource requests with a fifteen-minute aging fence and mandatory explicit profiles

replay.detail: Queued finite memberships retain their authoritative class and FIFO position; once aged, a waiting predecessor fences later admission until admission or withdrawal without adding a second resource charge.

schema.detail: Missing finite capacity profiles are refused with the typed missing-profile code. Byte-string parsing accepts exact unsigned decimal exponent notation and reports typed malformed or overflow errors.

rules.detail: Landing precedes check precedes agent. Within one class, fitting tickets may pass non-fitting predecessors before fifteen minutes; aged predecessors fence backfill. Memory including ARC credit, mount floors and reservations, and heavy IO tokens remain shared host budgets.

compatibility.detail: Finite requests without explicit profiles are no longer admitted. Existing unit-suffixed byte strings remain supported. No CLI flags or client-v0 schemas change.

downtime.detail: Existing holders retain their custody and reservations; the policy applies to new admission decisions.

manual.detail: Declare a capacity profile for every finite resource request. Exact byte strings such as 2e9 and 2000000000 denote the same count.

recovery.detail: Cancellation removes queued aging fences and existing dependency wakeups resume affected admissions. Aging uses a scheduled deadline rather than polling; impossible footprints are refused before queue ordering.
